prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / component correspondence. Make a clear four-panel design detail sheet explaining that the complete core robot in image 1 remains the same physical core inside the combined robot in image 2. Ivory landscape canvas, clean KINETIC_CEL ink/cel style. Two rows, each showing BEFORE on the left and ENHANCED STATE on the right, with one understated orange arrow between paired panels. No words or labels. This is a visual design study, not a dense engineering blueprint, and must not redesign either reference.

TOP ROW: two head-and-neck close-ups at the SAME FACE SCALE and same front three-quarter angle. Left EXACT core head from image 1: silver-white face, cyan eyes/forehead, two orange rising side horns, orange/ivory long mane behind. Right EXACT combined head from image 2: the SAME face/eyes and mane, now framed by its taller layered SILVER crown plates, orange center brow and cheek/crown armor. The crown plates are an expanded/raised armor state around the existing helmet, not another detached animal head, new face or aircraft nose. Show a few small meaningful hinge/separation joints at crown roots, not an extra fifth robot. Keep the recognizable orange/ivory hair and upgraded V17-like silver crown silhouette from image 2.

BOTTOM ROW: paired single forearm and clenched-fist close-ups, same three-quarter angle and SAME wrist-bone scale. Left the core's existing heavy orange shock gauntlet with cyan ring and white segmented knuckles from image 1. Right the enhanced giant fist from image 2, with thicker white finger/knuckle plates, orange structural forearm rings and expanded heavy layered palm armor. Show the same core arm continuing through the wrist; the right fist is physically bulkier due to reinforced/extended plating, not merely a differently zoomed image. Suggest one simple telescoping sleeve/armor expansion seam; avoid a precise mechanical transformation. NO TRAIN SHELL on either fist in this sheet, since the train shell is a separate OUTER attachment around the reinforced arm. No miniature train, aircraft engine, cannon or new limbs. Preserve the exact combined fist's weight and blocky plate language. Keep head and hand designs tied to their respective sources, not a generic lion, Gundam helmet or organic animal.
